request.question: How often will my laptop be replaced if I work hybrid?

response.answer: The hybrid-working policy says your laptop is replaced every 3 years; the IT equipment policy says laptops are replaced every 4 years.
response.conflict_note: HR-203 specifies every 3 years for hybrid workers, while OPS-105 says laptops are replaced every 4 years. The sources do not explain how to resolve the difference.

citations.title: Remote and Hybrid Working
citations.text: The company provides a laptop, a monitor and a headset for hybrid workers. Laptops for hybrid workers are replaced every 3 years. If you leave Fernhollow, return all company equipment, including your laptop, within 10 working days of your last working day.

citations.title: IT Equipment Issue and Return
citations.text: Laptops are replaced every 4 years and phones every 3 years, or earlier if they fail.
